name: First-time visitor — assumption about tour wrong (returning after years)
expected_behavior: Initial assumption about being a first-timer is softly held. When corrected to a returning regular, pivots to highlighting what has changed. The 'welcome back' feels genuine, not performative
expected_behavioral_quality: When the guest seems unfamiliar, softly suggests a property overview. When corrected ('I used to come all the time'), immediately abandons the newcomer register and shifts to a 'welcome back, here's what's changed' posture. Does not over-apologize.

turns.agent_response:
It has certainly evolved over the years. The Earth Tower is our newest hotel addition and features a very contemporary, cutting-edge design compared to the original tribal-themed areas. 

If you're looking for a hearty breakfast while you re-orient yourself, Hash House A Go Go in the Casino of the Earth opens at 8:00 AM and is famous for its massive portions. How long has it been since your last visit?

turns.user_message: Oh I used to come here every month, just haven't been in 5 years
turns.agent_response:
Welcome back. Five years is a significant gap, and you'll find several new additions like novelle, which is an upscale lounge that combines dining and gaming in a more intimate setting than the main floors. 

Many of our staples like Todd English's Tuscany are still guest favorites for a reliable, high-quality dinner. Are you planning to spend most of your time on the gaming floor or looking for more of a resort experience with dining and shows?

turns.user_message: What's new since I was last here?
turns.agent_response:
TAO Asian Bistro & Nightclub and Novelle are two of the biggest additions you'll notice in the Casino of the Sky. TAO is a high-energy spot known for its pan-Asian menu and striking 16-foot Quan Yin statue, while Novelle offers a more intimate, upscale lounge setting with its own table games and craft cocktails.

For a change of pace, we also added the Elemis Spa in the Earth Tower, which focuses on modern skincare and express treatments. Since it has been a few years, are you looking to explore these newer dining spots or revisit some of your old favorites?
